aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 11.1.7.4.1 through 11.1.7.4.5, 11.1.7.5 and 11.1.7.6 DO construct execution and DO CONCURRENT source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_114.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 238 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. authored_facets remains 1788 and the fixture review states remain 1770 reference-validated, 274 source-reviewed and 1 needs-oracle; this packet touches nothing under tests and claims no execution credit. Forty of the fifty scoped base units are newly accounted, because the ten numbered items R1135, C1138 and C1139 in 11.1.7.4.4 and C1140 through C1146 in 11.1.7.5 were already counted; 125 new facets remain pending. This is the most latitude-dense material in Clause 11. The locality rules for LOCAL, LOCAL_INIT, SHARED, REDUCE and unspecified locality were derived independently from the source before comparison, and Table 11.1 was verified row by row because extraction interleaves its columns. A variable with LOCAL locality is undefined at the start of each iteration except for default-initialized subobjects and undefined again after the construct, so reading, comparing or inquiring about it in that state would not be a conforming program; no plan does, and that unobservability claim is scoped to exactly that state rather than suppressing the plainly observable final value of a SHARED or REDUCE variable. Five permissions were accepted: any-order evaluation of the concurrent limit and step expressions, any-order execution of DO CONCURRENT iterations, the CYCLE curtailment effect, the processor's freedom to combine REDUCE values in any order, and processor-dependent sequential record ordering across iterations. No plan infers an iteration order, counts invocations, relies on a side effect or observes a temporary. The reduction trap was checked specifically: because combination order is free and real and complex values are approximations under 7.4.3 with reassociation permitted by 10.1.5.2.4, no REDUCE result over reals is used as a value oracle and only order-insensitive integer and logical reductions are planned. Both an attribution table and a separate implementability table were audited, the latter in both directions, confirming that nothing observable was suppressed and nothing marked implementable secretly requires order, timing or multi-image observation. 11.1.7.6 yields zero facets because it is examples. Several restrictions depend on unregistered Clause 15 purity and Clause 17 IEEE material and cannot be implemented until those clauses are registered. No DO construct execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
